req.title: Empty player list returns empty array
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players when the table is empty with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array.
triggers: empty player list returns empty array

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-025 requires that GET /players/ returns HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array when the player table is empty. The test suite must cover: (1) positive case — empty table yields 200 + []; (2) negative case — verifying the endpoint does NOT return a non-200 status or non-array body when the table is empty; (3) boundary case — the transition from zero rows to one row confirms the empty-array response is state-dependent. We override the DB session dependency to inject an in-memory SQLite session with no rows, ensuring determinism and isolation from the pre-loaded fixture data. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact body type and length ([] not just truthy), and exact header values.

import asyncio
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from main import app
from databases.player_database import Base, generate_async_session

engine = create_async_engine("sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:", future=True)
async def _setup():
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_setup())
AsyncTestSession = sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

async def override_session():
    async with AsyncTestSession() as session:
        yield session

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = override_session
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    r = client.get("/players/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 0
    assert body == []
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]

test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import asyncio
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from main import app
from databases.player_database import Base, generate_async_session
from schemas.player_schema import Player
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
from uuid import uuid4

engine3 = create_async_engine("sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:", future=True)
async def _setup3():
    async with engine3.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_setup3())
AsyncTestSession3 = sessionmaker(engine3, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

async def override_session3():
    async with AsyncTestSession3() as session:
        yield session

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = override_session3
client3 = TestClient(app)

def test_get_players_boundary_zero_vs_one_row():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(simple_memory_cache.clear(CACHE_KEY))
    r0 = client3.get("/players/")
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    assert r0.json() == []
    assert len(r0.json()) == 0
    async def _insert():
        async with AsyncTestSession3() as s:
            p = Player(id=uuid4(), first_name="Test", last_name="Player", squad_number=99, position="Goalkeeper")
            s.add(p)
            await s.commit()
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_insert())
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(simple_memory_cache.clear(CACHE_KEY))
    r1 = client3.get("/players/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert isinstance(body1, list)
    assert len(body1) == 1

test_get_players_boundary_zero_vs_one_row()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
